definitions.full: H5325. nitstsab נִצָּב noun masculine 1 haft, hilt of sword Judg 3:22 (Arabic handle of knife , 'in which the [i.e. the shank] is set' Lane 2800 ). 2 prefect, deputy , see נצב Niph`al 3.
